answer_1.quote: We focus on generating from graph structures in the form of Abstract Meaning Representations (AMR)... we propose a multilingual approach that can decode into twenty one different languages.
answer_1.outputs: Fluent natural language sentences in 21 target languages

answer_2.quote: We evaluate with detokenized BLEU using sacrebleu.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation by asking native speakers to evaluate word order, morphology, semantic faithfulness (with respect to the reference) and paraphrasing (how much the generation differs from the reference) on a 3 point scale.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators were asked to rate word order, morphology, semantic accuracy and paraphrasing of the generated sentences.
